name: sirius-login-errors
title: Serve cannot log in to Sirius
description: At least one Sirius login error was recorded in the last minute.
investigation_steps: Check the Serve application logs for the Sirius login error.
Identify the root cause of the login error, and see if more errors are occurring.
Check for any recent changes that might have affected Sirius authentication.
If the issue persists and affects production users, raise an incident and escalate.

query: | filter @message like /ERROR/ and @message like /publicapi/ and @message like /Request ->/
